ctx.x: I knew you made the records, but I didn't know you played trumpets with him.

Yeah, I played trumpet with him. That's where the woman liked to shot him down there one night. Really? Shot right through his coat and shirt right there. Well the blue singer, I forget her name. I'll tell you, her name was Ethel Cross. Ethel Cross. She was singing with me, she was a fool, you know. And they got to messing around with some other gal and they show them, she had a little automatic man. Shot right at him, shot right at home through there, that's who there. Another boy grabbed her, grabbed her hand.…
